reflection.text:
Unblinded as methotrexate, a dihydrofolate reductase inhibitor with truth class DNA replication, I concluded DNA damage at p=0.30 over Protein degradation at 0.22 with DNA replication only at 0.12. All four acquired wells from 0.03 to 10 uM showed the same saturated phenotype of very dim mean DNA (nuc_dna_mean z=-9.6 to -11.9) with enlarged spread cells (cell_area z=+5.6 to +9.4) and intact cytoskeleton, so low confidence was appropriate but the rank order was wrong.

The error was driven by over-weighting the reference-atlas comparison: NSC was tied 2/4 for DNA damage versus 2/4 for Protein degradation with low similarities 0.312-0.40 and summed similarity 0.743 vs 0.648 favoring DNA damage, plus k-neighbours 3/10 DNA damage. I treated very dim DNA plus large cells as damage-like and discounted that antifolate S-phase blockade produces the same enlarged low-DNA interphase state, especially because methotrexate-induced uracil misincorporation into DNA (PMID 6929529) creates damage-like lesions and inappropriate S-phase progression itself causes instability (PMID 7606822), explaining the atlas overlap noted in the antifolate literature (PMID 17333344).

Acquisition reinforced the trap: I spent all four wells on 0.03, 0.3, 1 and 10 uM, all already saturated with flat dose-responses for nuc_dna_mean rho=-0.20 p=0.8, cell_area rho=-0.40 p=0.6 and cell_count rho=-0.20 p=0.8, leaving budget exhausted so the requested dose_index=0 onset well could not be acquired to map threshold or discriminate damage from replication arrest.
what_was_right: Excluded actin disruptors and microtubule stabilizers/destabilizers and mitotic classes based on intact tubulin across doses (tub_mean rho=+0.00 p=1) and low mitotic-like fraction with visual intact tubulin/actin in describe_phenotype.
Recognized the phenotype as saturated and non-specific from 0.03 to 10 uM and kept probability low at 0.30 vs runner-up 0.22, explicitly noting the 2-2 NSC tie with low similarity.
Treated the signal as replicated across 4 wells not a single-well artifact, using nuc_dna_mean z=-9.6 to -11.9 plus cell_area z=+5.6 to +9.4 and nuc_solidity to define a large flat dim-DNA state.
what_was_wrong: Favored DNA damage over DNA replication on NSC summed similarity 0.743 vs 0.648 despite a 2-2 vote tie and low per-well similarities, and k-neighbour plurality 3/10 DNA damage.

Kept true class DNA replication at 0.08-0.12 despite persistent dim integrated DNA and enlarged cells with low mitosis that fit antifolate S-phase arrest, misreading uracil-misincorporation damage-like signal as primary DNA damage.
Acquired only the saturated 0.03-10 uM range with flat dose-responses and exhausted budget, so no titration below 0.03 uM or EdU versus damage-foci discriminant was obtained.

## Reflection

Unblinded as methotrexate, a dihydrofolate reductase inhibitor with truth class DNA replication, I concluded DNA damage at p=0.30 over Protein degradation at 0.22 with DNA replication only at 0.12. All four acquired wells from 0.03 to 10 uM showed the same saturated phenotype of very dim mean DNA (nuc_dna_mean z=-9.6 to -11.9) with enlarged spread cells (cell_area z=+5.6 to +9.4) and intact cytoskeleton, so low confidence was appropriate but the rank order was wrong.

What was wrong or missed:
- Favored DNA damage over DNA replication on NSC summed similarity 0.743 vs 0.648 despite a 2-2 vote tie and low per-well similarities, and k-neighbour plurality 3/10 DNA damage.
- Kept true class DNA replication at 0.08-0.12 despite persistent dim integrated DNA and enlarged cells with low mitosis that fit antifolate S-phase arrest, misreading uracil-misincorporation damage-like signal as primary DNA damage.
- Acquired only the saturated 0.03-10 uM range with flat dose-responses and exhausted budget, so no titration below 0.03 uM or EdU versus damage-foci discriminant was obtained.

Proposed next experiment: Titrate methotrexate below 0.03 uM to find onset and co-measure EdU incorporation for S-phase arrest versus gamma-H2AX/53BP1 foci for direct DNA damage versus proteasome activity, with DNA-content flow to test DHFR-inhibitor replication block.
